title: OKS Source Envelope v0.1
description: An Agent submits a SourceEnvelope to tell OKS 'I have captured a source'. The envelope identifies the source, who captured it, when, and a content hash for deduplication. It does NOT contain the evidence itself — evidence is declared in the EvidenceManifest.

source_id.description: Stable identifier generated by the Agent, typically based on source URI + timestamp hash.

source_uri.description: Original source — file path, URL, clipboard identifier, etc.

source_modality.description: The modality of the source material.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime in UTC when the source was captured.

captured_by.description: Identity of the Agent (or tool) that captured this source.

runtime.description: Runtime identifier: claude-code, codex, pymupdf4llm, etc.

model.description: Model identifier if an AI model performed the capture, null for mechanical tools.

skill.description: Skill or integration name that produced this capture.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the full evidence content for deduplication and integrity.

title.description: Human-readable title of the source, if known.

user_note.description: Optional human note about the source.

evidence_manifest_ref.description: Reference to the accompanying EvidenceManifest (manifest_id or file hash).

policy.description: Processing policy set by user or Agent for this source.

remote_processing.description: Whether remote API/Provider calls are permitted for this source.
